Execute **TD2 residual tech-debt governance** after the 2026-07-29 principal architecture audit: clear the single failing debt gate, restore hotspot headroom, review remaining internal shims, refresh audit snapshots, and ratchet script zero-ref debt — **without** budget growth and **without** re-litigating permanent public CLI/composition entrypoints.

## Constraints

1. **No debt budget growth** (exemptions, transition_compat, uncovered, facades, etc.).
2. Domain I/O-free; DI only in Composition Root.
3. Permanent public CLI/composition seams (**12 entrypoints / 4 facades**) are **not** dead code.
4. Prefer evidence + ratchet-down; never weaken gates to close issues.
5. Agent/memory runtimes stay out of `src/bioetl`.
